tableLines.line: 📖 Codex: Antler Sweep — strikes one target after a windup. You won't forget this.
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)
📖 Codex: Drink — strikes one target after a windup. You won't forget this.

"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
📖 Codex: Compulsion — strikes one target after a windup. You won't forget this.
✨ Ability gained: Long Table (L1). Share food with everyone in camp to reduce their hunger. Costs 300 kcal; once a day.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Robin speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
📖 Codex: Antler Sweep — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.

With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Tiana speaks at Ashford's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🧳 Thornfield has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
